deck.title: HTML-to-PPTX Deck Generator
deck.subtitle: A minimal HTML rendering loop for editable PPT export
deck.author: Codex

slides.title: HTML-to-PPTX Deck Generator
slides.subtitle: 用固定模板、结构化数据和浏览器预览建立第一版 PPT 生成闭环。
slides.author: Codex

slides.title: 第三阶段覆盖范围
items: 建立首批可复用组件目录
让 renderer 按 layout 读取组件模板
用 schema 限制组件输入容量
为组件生成 preview.png 预览图

slides.title: 组件库接入
slides.subtitle: 正文页优先选择稳定组件，减少每次自由排版带来的溢出和导出风险。

content.leftBody: Templates and component CSS are reusable assets. Codex should fill data into them instead of rewriting visual structure every time.
content.rightBody: The generated HTML keeps text, table cells, simple shapes and images as separate DOM nodes for later PPTX export.

cards.title: Template
cards.body: Controls the fixed slide frame, title hierarchy, footer and safe area.

cards.title: Component
cards.body: Controls reusable content structure such as cards, tables, flows and image-text blocks.

cards.title: Data
cards.body: Provides titles, bullets, table rows, figure paths and references without complex CSS.

steps.title: Plan
steps.description: Confirm page list, slide type, content source and component choice.

steps.title: Data
steps.description: Write deck.data.json with structure and content only.

steps.title: Render
steps.description: Combine templates, component HTML and theme CSS into deck.html.

steps.title: Check
steps.description: Run overflow, layout, asset and screenshot validation before export.

content.imageCaption: Local SVG asset used as a stable figure source.
content.title: Figure plus explanation
content.body: Image-text pages keep the figure and narrative separate, making the exported PPT easier to inspect and edit.

slides.title: Ready for Export
slides.subtitle: 下一阶段可以接入油猴脚本和 dom-to-pptx，验证 HTML 到 PPTX 的可编辑导出。
